notes.title: The Super Pie Throwing Ver. 1.00.02 Released!
notes.content:
The Super Pie Throwing v. 1.00.02 is out!

Fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue in which starting a game with no save data will cause some medals to be pre-unlocked
[/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed an issue in which starting a game with no save data will cause some medals to be pre-unlocked

notes.title: The Super Pie Throwing Ver. 1.00.01 Released!
notes.content:
The Super Pie Throwing v. 1.00.01 is out!

Changes:
[list]
[*]Mouse cursor will no longer display
[*]Minor changes to stick deadzone settings
[/list]

Fixes:
[list]
[*]A bug that caused issues for basic gameplay and cutscenes specific to computers with certain region settings has been addressed
[*]Minor text display issues for the Japanese version have been addressed
[/list]
